task: image k-NN accuracy on Imagenette (frozen features, no training)

protocol.centroid: nearest L2-normalised class-mean of the L2-normalised gallery features
protocol.agreement: fraction of query items whose kNN prediction equals PyTorch's
protocol.feat_cos: mean / worst per-item cosine between the jepa.cpp and PyTorch query features
protocol.margin: cosine to the best gallery neighbour minus the cosine to the best neighbour of any other class, computed on the PyTorch features; near 0 = the top two classes are tied and a tiny feature perturbation flips the vote
protocol.flip_*: of the items whose prediction differs from PyTorch's, how many PyTorch got right, how many jepa.cpp got right, and how many both got wrong

recipe.train2000: numpy default_rng(0).choice(n_class_files, 200, replace=False), sorted, per class in sorted-wnid order; indices into the sorted *.JPEG list
recipe.train_full: every train image, per class in sorted-wnid order
recipe.val: every val image, per class in sorted-wnid order
